feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: A judge blocks construction of Trump's arch moments after it won federal approval
entry.summary: The Trump administration hoped to begin construction immediately after a federal panel approved its arch late Thursday. But just after midnight, the judge issued an order blocking work for 14 days.

entry.title: Fears of an AI crackdown after midterms spark $2 trillion rout in tech stocks
entry.summary: Shares sank, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq dropping over 5%, as investors reacted with fear that a Democratic Congress — and states across the country -— would crack down on AI and data centers.

entry.title: These are the races in the House and Senate that haven't been called yet
entry.summary: Democrats are poised to have a strong majority in the upcoming Congress. The final numbers are still being determined. Here's where things stand in the races that are waiting to be called by the AP.

entry.title: Melania Trump touts rare agreement she brokered between Russia and Ukraine
entry.summary: The six-day pause from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky comes as the administration ramps up efforts to secure an agreement to end the war in Ukraine.

entry.title: How North Carolina Democrats flipped several House seats in historically GOP districts
entry.summary: All of these seats were in districts redrawn in 2023 to favor Republican candidates.

entry.title: Paraguay's president is impeached minutes after resigning following a bank collapse
entry.summary: Paraguayan lawmakers voted to impeach President Santiago Peña minutes after his resignation, as the collapse of a digital bank tied to his government froze millions of people's savings.

entry.title: Head of Justice Department office on Civil Rights resigns
entry.summary: The head of the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division, Harmeet Dhillon, is out after 18 tumultuous months in charge.

entry.title: Tiny Desk Radio: Joan Shelley, Melissa Aldana with Gonzalo Rubalcaba, Ganavya
entry.summary: Reflection, renewal. On this episode, we provide a musical reset for the mind. Look for Tiny Desk Radio on your local NPR station.

entry.title: With humor, heart and homunculi, 'Small Prophets' is a gentle marvel
entry.summary: A man calls forth magical spirits in an effort to find his long-missing girlfriend in this new British comedy-fantasy. Original and surprising, Small Prophets imbues daily life with poetic touches.

entry.title: Discursive Verses: Is 'Spend Dat' the best financial indicator of America's grift economy?
entry.summary: NPR Music culture critic and reporter Rodney Carmichael ruminates on the latest in rap culture. This week: How Yung Miami's summer bop became a sweeping indictment.
